functions.name: cairo_version
functions.description: Returns the encoded cairo version number of the library linked at runtime. Typical usage: feature checks or logging.
requirements: No arguments; safe to call anytime after the library is loaded.
Return is an integer encoded as (major*10000 + minor*100 + micro).

functions.name: cairo_version_string
functions.description: Returns a human-readable string for the cairo version of the library linked at runtime.
requirements: Returns a NUL-terminated string constant; do not free.
Pointer remains valid for the process lifetime.

functions.name: cairo_pattern_set_dither
functions.description: Sets the dithering preference on a pattern to control how quantization error is distributed when rendering gradients/images on low-depth outputs.
requirements: pattern must be a valid, initialized cairo_pattern_t.
dither must be one of cairo_dither_t enum values.
No return value; errors are recorded on the pattern’s status.

functions.name: cairo_pattern_get_dither
functions.description: Gets the current dithering mode set on a pattern.
requirements: pattern must be a valid, initialized cairo_pattern_t.

functions.name: cairo_create
functions.description: Creates a new drawing context for the given target surface.
requirements: target must be a valid cairo_surface_t (not finished).
Returns a new cairo_t with reference count 1; destroy with cairo_destroy().
On error, the returned context will be in an error status (check with cairo_status()).

functions.name: cairo_reference
functions.description: Increments the reference count of the cairo context and returns the same pointer.
requirements: cr must be a valid cairo_t pointer.
Balance each reference with cairo_destroy().

functions.name: cairo_destroy
functions.description: Decrements the reference count of the cairo context, destroying it when it reaches zero.
requirements: cr must be either NULL or a valid cairo_t. Passing NULL is a no-op in typical cairo style (unspecified here, but widely followed).
After final destroy, the pointer must not be used.

functions.name: cairo_get_reference_count
functions.description: Returns the current reference count of the cairo context.
requirements: cr must be a valid cairo_t.

functions.name: cairo_get_user_data
functions.description: Retrieves user data previously associated with the context for a specific key.
requirements: cr must be a valid cairo_t.
key must be the same address used when setting the data.
Returns the pointer set or NULL if not set.

functions.name: cairo_set_user_data
functions.signature: cairo_public cairo_status_t cairo_set_user_data (cairo_t *cr, const cairo_user_data_key_t *key, void *user_data, cairo_destroy_func_t destroy);
functions.description: Associates an opaque user_data pointer with the context under the given key; an optional destroy callback will be called when replaced or when the context is destroyed.
requirements: cr must be a valid cairo_t.
key must be a stable, unique address (e.g., address of a static cairo_user_data_key_t).
If user_data replaces an existing one for the same key, the previous destroy will be called.
destroy may be NULL if no destructor is needed.
Check return status for errors.

functions.name: cairo_save
functions.description: Pushes a copy of the current graphics state onto a stack for later restore.
requirements: cr must be valid.
Each cairo_save() must be balanced with a matching cairo_restore().

functions.name: cairo_restore
functions.description: Restores the most recently saved graphics state and removes it from the stack.
requirements: cr must be valid.
There must be a matching prior cairo_save(); otherwise context will enter CAIRO_STATUS_INVALID_RESTORE.

functions.name: cairo_push_group
functions.description: Pushes a new transparent intermediate group onto the stack; subsequent drawing is recorded to an intermediate surface until popped.
requirements: cr must be valid.
Must be balanced with cairo_pop_group() or cairo_pop_group_to_source().

functions.name: cairo_push_group_with_content
functions.description: Like cairo_push_group() but specifies the content type (color/alpha) of the group.
requirements: cr must be valid.
content must be a valid cairo_content_t value.
Must be balanced with pop functions.

functions.name: cairo_pop_group
functions.description: Pops the current group off the stack and returns it as a pattern without setting it as source.
requirements: cr must have a pushed group; otherwise CAIRO_STATUS_INVALID_POP_GROUP.
Returned pattern has refcount 1; destroy with cairo_pattern_destroy() or set as source to transfer ownership.

functions.name: cairo_pop_group_to_source
functions.description: Pops the current group and sets it as the source pattern for subsequent drawing.
requirements: cr must have a pushed group; otherwise CAIRO_STATUS_INVALID_POP_GROUP.

functions.name: cairo_set_operator
functions.description: Sets the compositing operator used for subsequent drawing operations.
requirements: cr must be valid.
op must be a value of cairo_operator_t.

functions.name: cairo_set_source
functions.description: Sets the current source pattern used for painting, stroking, and filling.
requirements: cr must be valid.
source must be a valid cairo_pattern_t (its lifetime must outlive use unless cairo retains a reference internally).

functions.name: cairo_set_source_rgb
functions.signature: cairo_public void cairo_set_source_rgb (cairo_t *cr, double red, double green, double blue);
functions.description: Convenience to set a solid color source with full opacity.
requirements: Color components are doubles; typical range 0.0..1.0 (not strictly documented here but standard cairo convention).

functions.name: cairo_set_source_rgba
functions.signature: cairo_public void cairo_set_source_rgba (cairo_t *cr, double red, double green, double blue, double alpha);
functions.description: Convenience to set a solid color source with specified alpha.
requirements: Color components and alpha are doubles; typical range 0.0..1.0.

functions.name: cairo_set_source_surface
functions.signature: cairo_public void cairo_set_source_surface (cairo_t *cr, cairo_surface_t *surface, double x, double y);
functions.description: Sets a surface pattern as the source with the surface positioned at (x, y) in user space.
requirements: cr must be valid.
surface must be a valid cairo_surface_t.
Surface should not be finished while in use as source.

functions.name: cairo_set_tolerance
functions.description: Sets the tolerance used when converting paths into trapezoids; lower values increase accuracy at cost of performance.
requirements: tolerance must be non-negative (implied by cairo semantics; not explicitly stated here).

functions.name: cairo_set_antialias
functions.description: Sets the antialiasing mode used for rendering shapes and text.
requirements: antialias must be a value of cairo_antialias_t.

functions.name: cairo_set_fill_rule
functions.description: Sets the fill rule (winding or even-odd) used when filling paths.
requirements: fill_rule must be a value of cairo_fill_rule_t.

functions.name: cairo_set_line_width
functions.description: Sets the line width for stroking operations in user-space units.
requirements: width should be non-negative (negative widths are invalid in cairo semantics).

functions.name: cairo_set_hairline
functions.description: Enables or disables hairline stroking, where stroke is rendered with device-space minimal width.
requirements: set_hairline should be 0 or 1 (cairo_bool_t).

functions.name: cairo_set_line_cap
functions.description: Sets how the ends of lines are rendered when stroking (butt, round, square).
requirements: line_cap must be a value of cairo_line_cap_t.

functions.name: cairo_set_line_join
functions.description: Sets how corners are rendered where two lines meet when stroking (miter, round, bevel).
requirements: line_join must be a value of cairo_line_join_t.

functions.name: cairo_set_dash
functions.signature: cairo_public void cairo_set_dash (cairo_t *cr, const double *dashes, int num_dashes, double offset);
functions.description: Sets the dash pattern for stroking: an array of on/off lengths and a phase offset.
requirements: If num_dashes > 0, dashes must point to at least num_dashes doubles.
num_dashes must be >= 0; negative counts are invalid.
Dash lengths should be non-negative; all zeros yields a solid line per cairo semantics.

functions.name: cairo_set_miter_limit
functions.description: Sets the miter limit for miter joins controlling when they are converted to bevel joins.
requirements: limit must be >= 1.0 for effect (values < 1 are nonsensical for miter; cairo treats invalid values as errors).

functions.name: cairo_translate
functions.signature: cairo_public void cairo_translate (cairo_t *cr, double tx, double ty);
functions.description: Applies a translation to the current transformation matrix (CTM).
requirements: No specific constraints beyond valid cr.

functions.name: cairo_scale
functions.signature: cairo_public void cairo_scale (cairo_t *cr, double sx, double sy);
functions.description: Applies a scaling to the CTM.
requirements: Scaling by zero makes the CTM non-invertible and may cause CAIRO_STATUS_INVALID_MATRIX in operations requiring inversion.

functions.name: cairo_rotate
functions.description: Applies a rotation (in radians) to the CTM.
requirements: angle in radians; no other specific constraints.

functions.name: cairo_transform
functions.description: Applies a transformation by multiplying the CTM by the given matrix.
requirements: matrix must point to a valid cairo_matrix_t.

functions.name: cairo_set_matrix
functions.description: Replaces the CTM with the specified matrix.
requirements: matrix must point to a valid cairo_matrix_t (prefer invertible for operations that need inversion).

functions.name: cairo_identity_matrix
functions.description: Resets the CTM to the identity matrix.

functions.name: cairo_user_to_device
functions.description: Transforms point coordinates in-place from user space to device space using the CTM.
requirements: x and y must be non-NULL pointers to doubles.

functions.name: cairo_user_to_device_distance
functions.description: Transforms a distance vector (no translation) from user to device space using the CTM.
requirements: dx and dy must be non-NULL pointers to doubles.

functions.name: cairo_device_to_user
functions.description: Transforms point coordinates in-place from device space to user space using the inverse CTM.
requirements: x and y must be non-NULL.
If CTM is not invertible, context will have CAIRO_STATUS_INVALID_MATRIX and values are undefined.

functions.name: cairo_device_to_user_distance
functions.description: Transforms a distance vector from device to user space using the inverse CTM.
requirements: dx and dy must be non-NULL.
If CTM is not invertible, context will have CAIRO_STATUS_INVALID_MATRIX.

functions.name: cairo_new_path
functions.description: Clears the current path; after this there is no current point until a move_to.

functions.name: cairo_move_to
functions.signature: cairo_public void cairo_move_to (cairo_t *cr, double x, double y);
functions.description: Begins a new subpath and sets the current point to (x, y).

functions.name: cairo_new_sub_path
functions.description: Starts a new subpath without clearing existing path data; the next drawing command begins a new disconnected contour.

functions.name: cairo_line_to
functions.signature: cairo_public void cairo_line_to (cairo_t *cr, double x, double y);
functions.description: Adds a line from the current point to (x, y) and updates the current point.
requirements: Requires a current point; otherwise behaves as move_to in cairo semantics.

functions.name: cairo_curve_to
functions.signature: cairo_public void cairo_curve_to (cairo_t *cr, double x1, double y1, double x2, double y2, double x3, double y3);
functions.description: Adds a cubic Bézier curve to the path from the current point to (x3, y3) with control points (x1, y1) and (x2, y2).
requirements: Requires a current point.

functions.name: cairo_arc
functions.signature: cairo_public void cairo_arc (cairo_t *cr, double xc, double yc, double radius, double angle1, double angle2);
functions.description: Adds a circular arc to the path in the positive (counter-clockwise) direction from angle1 to angle2 around center (xc, yc).
requirements: radius must be non-negative.
Angles are in radians.

functions.name: cairo_arc_negative
functions.signature: cairo_public void cairo_arc_negative (cairo_t *cr, double xc, double yc, double radius, double angle1, double angle2);
functions.description: Adds a circular arc to the path in the negative (clockwise) direction from angle1 to angle2.
requirements: radius must be non-negative.
Angles are in radians.

functions.name: cairo_rel_move_to
functions.signature: cairo_public void cairo_rel_move_to (cairo_t *cr, double dx, double dy);
functions.description: Starts a new subpath at a position relative to the current point by (dx, dy).
requirements: If no current point exists, behaves like move_to with (dx,dy) relative to (0,0) per cairo semantics.

functions.name: cairo_rel_line_to
functions.signature: cairo_public void cairo_rel_line_to (cairo_t *cr, double dx, double dy);
functions.description: Adds a line from the current point to a point offset by (dx, dy).
requirements: Requires a current point.

functions.name: cairo_rel_curve_to
functions.signature: cairo_public void cairo_rel_curve_to (cairo_t *cr, double dx1, double dy1, double dx2, double dy2, double dx3, double dy3);
functions.description: Adds a cubic Bézier curve using relative coordinates from the current point.
requirements: Requires a current point.

functions.name: cairo_rectangle
functions.signature: cairo_public void cairo_rectangle (cairo_t *cr, double x, double y, double width, double height);
functions.description: Adds a rectangle path from top-left (x,y) with given width and height.
requirements: Width and height should be non-negative.

functions.name: cairo_close_path
functions.description: Closes the current subpath by adding a line from current point to the subpath’s starting point; creates a closed contour.
requirements: Has effect only if a current subpath exists.

functions.name: cairo_path_extents
functions.signature: cairo_public void cairo_path_extents (cairo_t *cr, double *x1, double *y1, double *x2, double *y2);
functions.description: Computes a bounding box of the current path in user-space coordinates.
requirements: x1,y1,x2,y2 must be non-NULL pointers to doubles.

functions.name: cairo_paint
functions.description: Paints the current source everywhere within the current clip.
requirements: Ensure a valid source is set (defaults to solid black if none is set, per cairo behavior).

functions.name: cairo_paint_with_alpha
functions.description: Paints the current source everywhere within the current clip multiplied by alpha.
requirements: alpha typically in [0,1].

functions.name: cairo_mask
functions.description: Uses pattern as a mask to composite the current source into the destination.
requirements: pattern must be a valid pattern; its type must be appropriate for masking.
The current source must be set.

functions.name: cairo_mask_surface
functions.signature: cairo_public void cairo_mask_surface (cairo_t *cr, cairo_surface_t *surface, double surface_x, double surface_y);
functions.description: Convenience for masking with a surface pattern positioned at (surface_x, surface_y).
requirements: surface must be a valid cairo_surface_t.
Current source must be set.

functions.name: cairo_stroke
functions.description: Strokes the current path with current stroke settings and clears the path.
requirements: A path may be empty; then nothing is drawn.

functions.name: cairo_stroke_preserve
functions.description: Strokes the current path but preserves it for further operations.

functions.name: cairo_fill
functions.description: Fills the current path using the current fill rule and clears the path.

functions.name: cairo_fill_preserve
functions.description: Fills the current path but preserves it.

functions.name: cairo_copy_page
functions.description: Emits a copy of the current page to the backend (for multi-page surfaces) without clearing it.
requirements: Only meaningful on paginated surfaces; otherwise a no-op.

functions.name: cairo_show_page
functions.description: Finishes the current page and starts a new one on paginated surfaces.
requirements: Only meaningful on paginated surfaces; otherwise a no-op.

functions.name: cairo_in_stroke
functions.signature: cairo_public cairo_bool_t cairo_in_stroke (cairo_t *cr, double x, double y);
functions.description: Returns whether the given point is inside the area that would be affected by stroking the current path.

functions.name: cairo_in_fill
functions.signature: cairo_public cairo_bool_t cairo_in_fill (cairo_t *cr, double x, double y);
functions.description: Returns whether the given point is inside the area that would be filled by the current path.

functions.name: cairo_in_clip
functions.signature: cairo_public cairo_bool_t cairo_in_clip (cairo_t *cr, double x, double y);
functions.description: Returns whether the given point is inside the current clip region.

functions.name: cairo_stroke_extents
functions.signature: cairo_public void cairo_stroke_extents (cairo_t *cr, double *x1, double *y1, double *x2, double *y2);
functions.description: Computes a bounding box of the stroke extents for the current path.
requirements: x1,y1,x2,y2 must be non-NULL.

functions.name: cairo_fill_extents
functions.signature: cairo_public void cairo_fill_extents (cairo_t *cr, double *x1, double *y1, double *x2, double *y2);
functions.description: Computes a bounding box of the fill extents for the current path.
requirements: x1,y1,x2,y2 must be non-NULL.

functions.name: cairo_reset_clip
functions.description: Clears any active clipping region on the context.

functions.name: cairo_clip
functions.description: Establishes a new clip region by intersecting the current path with the existing clip and then clears the path.
requirements: Path can be empty; then clip is unchanged.

functions.name: cairo_clip_preserve
functions.description: Like cairo_clip() but preserves the path.

functions.name: cairo_clip_extents
functions.signature: cairo_public void cairo_clip_extents (cairo_t *cr, double *x1, double *y1, double *x2, double *y2);
functions.description: Computes a bounding box that is guaranteed to contain the current clip region.
requirements: x1,y1,x2,y2 must be non-NULL.

functions.name: cairo_copy_clip_rectangle_list
functions.description: Returns a dynamically allocated list of rectangles approximating the current clip region.
requirements: Returned cairo_rectangle_list_t must be destroyed with cairo_rectangle_list_destroy().
Check rectangle_list->status for errors.

functions.name: cairo_rectangle_list_destroy
functions.description: Frees a cairo_rectangle_list_t returned from cairo_copy_clip_rectangle_list().
requirements: rectangle_list may be NULL; otherwise must be the pointer returned by the copy function and not freed earlier.

functions.name: cairo_tag_begin
functions.signature: cairo_public void cairo_tag_begin (cairo_t *cr, const char *tag_name, const char *attributes);
functions.description: Begins a logical-structure tag, e.g., for PDFs. A matching cairo_tag_end() with the same tag_name must follow.
requirements: tag_name must be a non-NULL valid tag identifier.
attributes may be NULL or a string of attributes per backend expectations.
Must be balanced with cairo_tag_end(cr, tag_name).

functions.name: cairo_tag_end
functions.description: Ends a logical-structure tag started by cairo_tag_begin() with the same tag_name.
requirements: Must correspond to a prior cairo_tag_begin() with identical tag_name; otherwise CAIRO_STATUS_TAG_ERROR.

functions.name: cairo_glyph_allocate
functions.description: Allocates an array of cairo_glyph_t of length num_glyphs.
requirements: num_glyphs must be >= 0.
Must be freed with cairo_glyph_free().

functions.name: cairo_glyph_free
functions.description: Frees an array allocated by cairo_glyph_allocate().
requirements: glyphs may be NULL; otherwise must be allocated by cairo_glyph_allocate().

functions.name: cairo_text_cluster_allocate
functions.description: Allocates an array of cairo_text_cluster_t of length num_clusters.
requirements: num_clusters must be >= 0.
Free with cairo_text_cluster_free().

functions.name: cairo_text_cluster_free
functions.description: Frees an array allocated by cairo_text_cluster_allocate().
requirements: clusters may be NULL; otherwise must be allocated by cairo_text_cluster_allocate().

functions.name: cairo_font_options_create
functions.description: Creates a new cairo_font_options_t with all font rendering options set to their defaults. Use to configure antialiasing, hinting, variations, and color font options for text rendering.
requirements: Caller must destroy the returned object with cairo_font_options_destroy() when no longer needed.

functions.name: cairo_font_options_copy
functions.description: Creates a deep copy of an existing cairo_font_options_t.
requirements: original must be a valid, initialized cairo_font_options_t (may be NULL to return a new default options object depending on backend version; if behavior is unknown, treat NULL as invalid).
Caller must destroy the returned object with cairo_font_options_destroy().

functions.name: cairo_font_options_destroy
functions.description: Decrements the reference count of a cairo_font_options_t and frees resources when it reaches zero.
requirements: options may be NULL (a no-op in cairo API conventions).
Do not use options after destroying it.

functions.name: cairo_font_options_status
functions.description: Returns the error status of a cairo_font_options_t, or CAIRO_STATUS_SUCCESS if no error has occurred.
requirements: options must be a valid cairo_font_options_t pointer.

functions.name: cairo_font_options_merge
functions.description: Merges non-default values from other into options. Existing non-defaults in options are preserved.
requirements: options must be a valid, mutable cairo_font_options_t.
other must be a valid cairo_font_options_t.

functions.name: cairo_font_options_equal
functions.description: Compares two cairo_font_options_t for equality.
requirements: options and other must be valid pointers (may be the same object).

functions.name: cairo_font_options_hash
functions.description: Computes a hash value suitable for use in hash tables for a cairo_font_options_t.
requirements: options must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: cairo_font_options_set_antialias
functions.description: Sets the antialiasing mode for glyph rendering in the font options.
requirements: options must be a valid pointer.
antialias must be a value from cairo_antialias_t.

functions.name: cairo_font_options_get_antialias
functions.description: Gets the antialiasing mode from the font options.
requirements: options must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: cairo_font_options_set_subpixel_order
functions.description: Sets the LCD subpixel order for subpixel antialiasing.
requirements: options must be a valid pointer.
subpixel_order must be a value from cairo_subpixel_order_t.

functions.name: cairo_font_options_get_subpixel_order
functions.description: Gets the subpixel order from the font options.
requirements: options must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: cairo_font_options_set_hint_style
functions.description: Sets the hinting style for font outlines.
requirements: options must be a valid pointer.
hint_style must be a value from cairo_hint_style_t.

functions.name: cairo_font_options_get_hint_style
functions.description: Gets the hinting style from the font options.
requirements: options must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: cairo_font_options_set_hint_metrics
functions.description: Sets whether to hint font metrics (quantize advances/metrics to device pixels).
requirements: options must be a valid pointer.
hint_metrics must be a value from cairo_hint_metrics_t.

functions.name: cairo_font_options_get_hint_metrics
functions.description: Gets the hint metrics mode from the font options.
requirements: options must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: cairo_font_options_get_variations
functions.description: Returns the font-variations settings string (e.g., OpenType 'fvar' axes) currently set in options, or NULL if none. Format is backend-defined.
requirements: options must be a valid pointer.
Returned pointer is owned by options and must not be freed by the caller.

functions.name: cairo_font_options_set_variations
functions.description: Sets the font-variations settings string on options. Enables selecting variation axes values when supported by the font/backend.
requirements: options must be a valid pointer.
variations may be NULL to clear variations.
String format and accepted values are backend/font dependent; invalid strings may set an error status retrievable via cairo_font_options_status().

functions.name: cairo_font_options_set_color_mode
functions.description: Controls whether color glyphs should be used when rendering color fonts (e.g., OpenType-SVG/CBLC/COLR).
requirements: options must be a valid pointer.
color_mode must be a value from cairo_color_mode_t.

functions.name: cairo_font_options_get_color_mode
functions.description: Gets the color-glyph rendering mode from options.
requirements: options must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: cairo_font_options_get_color_palette
functions.description: Returns the selected color palette index for color fonts, or CAIRO_COLOR_PALETTE_DEFAULT if default.
requirements: options must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: cairo_font_options_set_color_palette
functions.description: Selects a color palette index for color fonts that support multiple palettes.
requirements: options must be a valid pointer.
palette_index must be a non-negative palette index supported by the font; out-of-range values may be ignored or cause an error state.

functions.name: cairo_font_options_set_custom_palette_color
functions.signature: void cairo_font_options_set_custom_palette_color (cairo_font_options_t *options, unsigned int index, double red, double green, double blue, double alpha);
functions.description: Sets or overrides a color entry in the selected custom palette by index with RGBA values.
requirements: options must be a valid pointer.
index must be within the palette range expected by the font/backend (exact limits are font/backend specific).
red, green, blue, alpha are doubles; valid range is typically 0.0 to 1.0.

functions.name: cairo_font_options_get_custom_palette_color
functions.signature: cairo_status_t cairo_font_options_get_custom_palette_color (cairo_font_options_t *options, unsigned int index, double *red, double *green, double *blue, double *alpha);
functions.description: Retrieves a custom palette color at index into the provided RGBA outputs.
requirements: options must be a valid pointer.
red, green, blue, alpha must be non-NULL pointers to receive values.
index must be within the range used for the custom palette.
Returns CAIRO_STATUS_SUCCESS on success or an error status otherwise.

functions.name: cairo_select_font_face
functions.signature: void cairo_select_font_face (cairo_t *cr, const char *family, cairo_font_slant_t slant, cairo_font_weight_t weight);
functions.description: Selects a simple (toy) font face on the cairo context by family name, slant, and weight. Use for quick text rendering without advanced font APIs.
requirements: cr must be a valid cairo_t.
family must be a UTF-8 string naming a font family (implementation-dependent matching).
slant must be a cairo_font_slant_t value.
weight must be a cairo_font_weight_t value.

functions.name: cairo_set_font_size
functions.description: Sets the current font size (scale) on the cairo context in user-space units.
requirements: cr must be a valid cairo_t.
size should be a non-negative double; negative sizes are invalid.

functions.name: cairo_set_font_matrix
functions.description: Sets a custom font transformation matrix on the cairo context, allowing non-uniform scaling, shear, and rotation of the font.
requirements: cr must be a valid cairo_t.
matrix must be a valid pointer to a cairo_matrix_t.

functions.name: cairo_get_font_matrix
functions.description: Retrieves the current font matrix from the cairo context.
requirements: cr must be a valid cairo_t.
matrix must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the matrix.

functions.name: cairo_set_font_options
functions.description: Sets font rendering options (antialiasing, hinting, variations, color mode, etc.) on the cairo context.
requirements: cr must be a valid cairo_t.
options must be a valid cairo_font_options_t pointer (may be backend-specific if NULL is allowed: unknown; pass a valid object).

functions.name: cairo_get_font_options
functions.description: Copies the current font options from the cairo context into options.
requirements: cr must be a valid cairo_t.
options must be a valid, initialized cairo_font_options_t to receive values.

functions.name: cairo_set_font_face
functions.description: Sets the font face object on the cairo context. Use in conjunction with size/matrix/options for precise text rendering.
requirements: cr must be a valid cairo_t.
font_face must be a valid cairo_font_face_t (may be NULL to unset; behavior is backend-defined).

functions.name: cairo_get_font_face
functions.description: Gets the currently set font face from the cairo context.
requirements: cr must be a valid cairo_t.
Returned pointer is owned by cairo; reference count rules follow cairo conventions (may need cairo_font_face_reference() if storing).

functions.name: cairo_set_scaled_font
functions.description: Sets a pre-constructed scaled font on the cairo context, fully specifying face, size, matrices, and options.
requirements: cr must be a valid cairo_t.
scaled_font must be a valid cairo_scaled_font_t pointer.

functions.name: cairo_get_scaled_font
functions.description: Returns the currently set scaled font from the cairo context.
requirements: cr must be a valid cairo_t.
Returned pointer follows cairo reference counting; call cairo_scaled_font_reference() if storing beyond the context's lifetime.

functions.name: cairo_show_text
functions.description: Shows a UTF-8 text string at the current point using the current source, font, and transformation on the cairo context.
requirements: cr must be a valid cairo_t with a current source and font settings.
utf8 must be a valid UTF-8 string (null-terminated).
For precise positioning/complex scripts, prefer glyph APIs.

functions.name: cairo_show_glyphs
functions.signature: void cairo_show_glyphs (cairo_t *cr, const cairo_glyph_t *glyphs, int num_glyphs);
functions.description: Renders an array of positioned glyphs using the current source and font. Allows exact control over glyph indices and positions.
requirements: cr must be a valid cairo_t.
glyphs must point to at least num_glyphs cairo_glyph_t elements.
num_glyphs must be >= 0.

functions.name: cairo_show_text_glyphs
functions.signature: void cairo_show_text_glyphs (cairo_t *cr, const char *utf8, int utf8_len, const cairo_glyph_t *glyphs, int num_glyphs, const cairo_text_cluster_t *clusters, int num_clusters, cairo_text_cluster_flags_t cluster_flags);
functions.description: Advanced text rendering combining UTF-8 text, glyph array, and cluster mapping for complex text shaping and selection. Enables precise mapping between text and glyphs.
requirements: cr must be a valid cairo_t.
If utf8 is non-NULL, utf8_len must be >= 0 and refer to bytes of UTF-8 text.
glyphs must point to at least num_glyphs elements when num_glyphs > 0.
If clusters is non-NULL, num_clusters must be >= 0; cluster_flags must be consistent with the mapping.
Cluster mapping should be valid: both counts non-negative and at least one non-zero per cluster, per documentation.

functions.name: cairo_text_path
functions.description: Adds the outline path of a UTF-8 text string to the current path of the cairo context without rendering it. Use together with stroking/filling.
requirements: cr must be a valid cairo_t.
utf8 must be a valid UTF-8 string.

functions.name: cairo_glyph_path
functions.signature: void cairo_glyph_path (cairo_t *cr, const cairo_glyph_t *glyphs, int num_glyphs);
functions.description: Adds the outline path of an array of glyphs to the current path of the cairo context without rendering.
requirements: cr must be a valid cairo_t.
glyphs must point to at least num_glyphs elements.
num_glyphs must be >= 0.

functions.name: cairo_text_extents
functions.description: Computes metrics (ink extents and advances) for a UTF-8 text string in user-space coordinates.
requirements: cr must be a valid cairo_t with a font selected.
utf8 must be a valid UTF-8 string.
extents must be a non-NULL pointer to receive results.

functions.name: cairo_glyph_extents
functions.signature: void cairo_glyph_extents (cairo_t *cr, const cairo_glyph_t *glyphs, int num_glyphs, cairo_text_extents_t *extents);
functions.description: Computes metrics for an array of glyphs in user-space coordinates.
requirements: cr must be a valid cairo_t with a font selected.
glyphs must point to at least num_glyphs elements; num_glyphs >= 0.
extents must be non-NULL.

functions.name: cairo_font_extents
functions.description: Retrieves overall font metrics (ascent, descent, height, max advances) for the current font in user-space coordinates.
requirements: cr must be a valid cairo_t with a font selected.
extents must be a non-NULL pointer.

functions.name: cairo_font_face_reference
functions.description: Increments the reference count of the given font face and returns the same pointer. Use to take shared ownership of a cairo_font_face_t.
requirements: font_face must be a valid cairo_font_face_t pointer (may be NULL-safe in cairo: if NULL, returns NULL).
Caller must later balance with cairo_font_face_destroy() to avoid leaks.

functions.name: cairo_font_face_destroy
functions.description: Decrements the reference count of the font face; when it reaches zero, resources are freed.
requirements: font_face must be a valid cairo_font_face_t pointer (NULL is allowed and is a no-op in cairo).
Do not use the font_face after its reference count reaches zero.

functions.name: cairo_font_face_get_reference_count
functions.description: Returns the current reference count of the font face.
requirements: font_face must be a valid cairo_font_face_t pointer.

functions.name: cairo_font_face_status
functions.description: Returns the current error status of the font face, or CAIRO_STATUS_SUCCESS if none.
requirements: font_face must be a valid cairo_font_face_t pointer.

functions.name: cairo_font_face_get_type
functions.description: Returns the backend/type of the font face (toy, FT, Win32, Quartz, USER, DWRITE).
requirements: font_face must be a valid cairo_font_face_t pointer.

functions.name: cairo_font_face_get_user_data
functions.description: Retrieves caller-associated user data stored on the font face for the provided key, or NULL if none.
requirements: font_face must be a valid cairo_font_face_t pointer.
key must be a valid address used when setting data; only the key address identity matters.

functions.name: cairo_font_face_set_user_data
functions.signature: cairo_status_t cairo_font_face_set_user_data (cairo_font_face_t *font_face, const cairo_user_data_key_t *key, void *user_data, cairo_destroy_func_t destroy);
functions.description: Associates arbitrary user data with the font face under the given key, with an optional destructor called when the data is replaced or the object is destroyed.
requirements: font_face must be a valid cairo_font_face_t pointer.
key must be a unique stable address (e.g., address of a static cairo_user_data_key_t).
If user_data is non-NULL and the key already has data, previous data’s destroy callback will be invoked before replacing.
destroy may be NULL; if provided, it must be safe to call at object destruction time.

functions.name: cairo_scaled_font_create
functions.signature: cairo_scaled_font_t * cairo_scaled_font_create (cairo_font_face_t *font_face, const cairo_matrix_t *font_matrix, const cairo_matrix_t *ctm, const cairo_font_options_t *options);
functions.description: Creates a scaled font for a specific size/transform/options combination, suitable for measuring or rendering text independent of a cairo_t.
requirements: font_face must be a valid, initialized cairo_font_face_t.
font_matrix must be a valid pointer to a transformation defining font space scaling (typically ascent+descent ~ 1.0).
ctm must be a valid pointer to the current transformation matrix to be used with this font.
options must be a valid pointer to cairo_font_options_t (can be default options).
On error, returns a scaled font in an error state; check with cairo_scaled_font_status().

functions.name: cairo_scaled_font_reference
functions.description: Increments the reference count of the scaled font and returns the same pointer.
requirements: scaled_font must be a valid cairo_scaled_font_t (NULL returns NULL).
Balance with cairo_scaled_font_destroy().

functions.name: cairo_scaled_font_destroy
functions.description: Decrements the reference count of the scaled font; when it reaches zero, frees resources.
requirements: scaled_font must be a valid cairo_scaled_font_t (NULL is allowed/no-op).
Do not use the object after final unref.

functions.name: cairo_scaled_font_get_reference_count
functions.description: Returns the current reference count of the scaled font.
requirements: scaled_font must be a valid cairo_scaled_font_t.

functions.name: cairo_scaled_font_status
functions.description: Gets the last error status of the scaled font, or CAIRO_STATUS_SUCCESS.
requirements: scaled_font must be a valid cairo_scaled_font_t.

functions.name: cairo_scaled_font_get_type
functions.description: Returns the backend/type of the scaled font (matching the font face type).
requirements: scaled_font must be a valid cairo_scaled_font_t.

functions.name: cairo_scaled_font_get_user_data
functions.description: Retrieves caller-associated user data stored on the scaled font under the given key, or NULL if none.
requirements: scaled_font must be a valid cairo_scaled_font_t.
key must be the same key address used when setting the data.

functions.name: cairo_scaled_font_set_user_data
functions.signature: cairo_status_t cairo_scaled_font_set_user_data (cairo_scaled_font_t *scaled_font, const cairo_user_data_key_t *key, void *user_data, cairo_destroy_func_t destroy);
functions.description: Associates arbitrary user data with the scaled font under the given key, with optional destructor for cleanup.
requirements: scaled_font must be a valid cairo_scaled_font_t.
key must be a unique stable address.
If replacing existing data for key, prior data’s destroy is called.
destroy may be NULL; if non-NULL it must tolerate being called at object destruction.

functions.name: cairo_scaled_font_extents
functions.description: Computes and returns font-wide metrics (ascent, descent, height, advances) for the scaled font in font/user space.
requirements: scaled_font must be a valid cairo_scaled_font_t.
extents must be a valid non-NULL output pointer.

functions.name: cairo_scaled_font_text_extents
functions.description: Measures the extents of the UTF-8 text string using the scaled font, without rendering.
requirements: scaled_font must be a valid cairo_scaled_font_t.
utf8 must point to valid UTF-8-encoded text (may be empty string).
extents must be a valid non-NULL output pointer.

functions.name: cairo_scaled_font_glyph_extents
functions.signature: void cairo_scaled_font_glyph_extents (cairo_scaled_font_t *scaled_font, const cairo_glyph_t *glyphs, int num_glyphs, cairo_text_extents_t *extents);
functions.description: Measures the extents of an array of positioned glyphs using the scaled font.
requirements: scaled_font must be valid.
glyphs must point to an array of at least num_glyphs cairo_glyph_t elements, or may be NULL if num_glyphs==0.
num_glyphs must be >= 0.
extents must be a valid non-NULL output pointer.

functions.name: cairo_scaled_font_text_to_glyphs
functions.signature: cairo_status_t cairo_scaled_font_text_to_glyphs (cairo_scaled_font_t *scaled_font, double x, double y, const char *utf8, int utf8_len, cairo_glyph_t **glyphs, int *num_glyphs, cairo_text_cluster_t **clusters, int *num_clusters, cairo_text_cluster_flags_t *cluster_flags);
functions.description: Converts UTF-8 text to positioned glyphs for the given scaled font, optionally also producing text clusters and cluster flags. The input x,y is the origin for layout.
requirements: scaled_font must be valid and initialized.
utf8 points to UTF-8 text; utf8_len is length in bytes (may be -1 for NUL-terminated, per cairo conventions; not explicitly stated here, so supply explicit length).
glyphs and num_glyphs must be valid pointers; on output, glyphs may point to allocated memory to be freed with cairo_glyph_free() by the caller if the pointer value changes from input.
If clusters, num_clusters, and cluster_flags are all non-NULL, clustering info may be returned; when clusters pointer value changes from input, free with cairo_text_cluster_free().
x and y are doubles giving the baseline origin in user/font space as per scaled font matrices.
On success returns CAIRO_STATUS_SUCCESS; on shaping-not-implemented may return CAIRO_STATUS_USER_FONT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED for user fonts.

functions.name: cairo_scaled_font_get_font_face
functions.description: Returns the underlying font face of the scaled font (does not change refcount).
requirements: scaled_font must be valid.
Returned pointer is owned by the scaled font; reference it if you need to keep it beyond the scaled font’s lifetime.

functions.name: cairo_scaled_font_get_font_matrix
functions.description: Retrieves the font matrix used to create the scaled font.
requirements: scaled_font must be valid.
font_matrix must be a valid non-NULL output pointer.

functions.name: cairo_scaled_font_get_ctm
functions.description: Retrieves the CTM used to create the scaled font.
requirements: scaled_font must be valid.
ctm must be a valid non-NULL output pointer.

functions.name: cairo_scaled_font_get_scale_matrix
functions.description: Retrieves the scale matrix (mapping from font space to device space) of the scaled font.
requirements: scaled_font must be valid.
scale_matrix must be a valid non-NULL output pointer.

functions.name: cairo_scaled_font_get_font_options
functions.description: Retrieves the font options used to create the scaled font into the provided options object.
requirements: scaled_font must be valid.
options must be a valid cairo_font_options_t pointer; contents will be overwritten.

functions.name: cairo_toy_font_face_create
functions.signature: cairo_font_face_t * cairo_toy_font_face_create (const char *family, cairo_font_slant_t slant, cairo_font_weight_t weight);
functions.description: Creates a simple (toy) font face for the given family name, slant, and weight. Useful with toy text APIs.
requirements: family must be a pointer to a UTF-8 family name string (e.g., "sans", "serif", "monospace").
slant and weight must be valid enum values.
On error, returns a font face in error state; check with cairo_font_face_status().

functions.name: cairo_toy_font_face_get_family
functions.description: Returns the family name string for a toy font face.
requirements: font_face must be a toy font face created via cairo_toy_font_face_create().
Returned pointer is owned by the font face; do not free.

functions.name: cairo_toy_font_face_get_slant
functions.description: Returns the slant attribute of a toy font face.
requirements: font_face must be a toy font face.

functions.name: cairo_toy_font_face_get_weight
functions.description: Returns the weight attribute of a toy font face.
requirements: font_face must be a toy font face.

functions.name: cairo_user_font_face_create
functions.description: Creates a new user font face whose glyph rendering and metrics are provided by user callbacks.
requirements: After creation, set callbacks with cairo_user_font_face_set_* before using with a scaled font.
Check error with cairo_font_face_status().

functions.name: cairo_user_font_face_set_init_func
functions.description: Sets the optional init callback to compute font extents for a user font face when a scaled font is created.
requirements: font_face must be a user font face created by cairo_user_font_face_create().
init_func may be NULL to use default extents.

functions.name: cairo_user_font_face_set_render_glyph_func
functions.description: Sets the mandatory (for non-color rendering) glyph rendering callback for a user font face.
requirements: font_face must be a user font face.
render_glyph_func must be non-NULL if color glyph func is not provided, else rendering may be undefined.
Callback must render into provided cairo_t in font space and set extents appropriately; avoid non-default sources.

functions.name: cairo_user_font_face_set_render_color_glyph_func
functions.description: Sets the optional color glyph rendering callback for a user font face. If returns CAIRO_STATUS_USER_FONT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED, cairo will fall back to non-color render callback.
requirements: font_face must be a user font face.
render_glyph_func may be NULL to disable color glyph handling.
When set, setting the source in the callback is allowed; default source is black.

functions.name: cairo_user_font_face_set_text_to_glyphs_func
functions.description: Sets the optional text-to-glyphs shaping callback for a user font face, used by cairo_show_text().
requirements: font_face must be a user font face.
text_to_glyphs_func may be NULL; cairo will then use unicode_to_glyph or identity mapping.

functions.name: cairo_user_font_face_set_unicode_to_glyph_func
functions.description: Sets the optional Unicode-to-glyph mapping callback for a user font face, used as fallback for text_to_glyphs.
requirements: font_face must be a user font face.
unicode_to_glyph_func may be NULL; identity mapping is assumed if both callbacks are absent or not implemented.

functions.name: cairo_user_font_face_get_init_func
functions.description: Gets the init callback previously set on a user font face, or NULL if none.
requirements: font_face must be a user font face.

functions.name: cairo_user_font_face_get_render_glyph_func
functions.description: Gets the non-color render_glyph callback for a user font face, or NULL if none.
requirements: font_face must be a user font face.

functions.name: cairo_user_font_face_get_render_color_glyph_func
functions.description: Gets the color render_glyph callback for a user font face, or NULL if none.
requirements: font_face must be a user font face.

functions.name: cairo_user_font_face_get_text_to_glyphs_func
functions.description: Gets the text_to_glyphs callback for a user font face, or NULL if none.
requirements: font_face must be a user font face.

functions.name: cairo_user_font_face_get_unicode_to_glyph_func
functions.description: Gets the unicode_to_glyph callback for a user font face, or NULL if none.
requirements: font_face must be a user font face.

functions.name: cairo_user_scaled_font_get_foreground_marker
functions.description: For user fonts with color rendering, returns a special marker pattern indicating the current foreground source at glyph render time. Useful to detect foreground usage.
requirements: scaled_font must be a valid cairo_scaled_font_t for a user font face.
Return is a cairo_pattern_t owned by cairo for inspection; treat as read-only.

functions.name: cairo_user_scaled_font_get_foreground_source
functions.description: For user fonts with color rendering, returns the current source pattern to be used as foreground when rendering the glyph.
requirements: scaled_font must be a valid cairo_scaled_font_t for a user font face.
Returned pattern is owned by cairo; reference it if you need to keep it.

functions.name: cairo_get_operator
functions.description: Gets the current compositing operator from the context.
requirements: cr must be a valid cairo_t.

functions.name: cairo_get_source
functions.description: Gets the current source pattern from the context (does not change refcount).
requirements: cr must be valid.
Reference the returned pattern if you need to keep it beyond the lifetime of cr or subsequent source changes.

functions.name: cairo_get_tolerance
functions.description: Gets the current curve approximation tolerance.
requirements: cr must be valid.

functions.name: cairo_get_antialias
functions.description: Gets the current antialiasing mode for the context.
requirements: cr must be valid.

functions.name: cairo_has_current_point
functions.description: Returns whether a current point is defined in the path of the context.
requirements: cr must be valid.

functions.name: cairo_get_current_point
functions.description: Gets the current point of the path, if any; results undefined if none. Prefer cairo_has_current_point() first.
requirements: cr must be valid.
x and y must be non-NULL output pointers.

functions.name: cairo_get_fill_rule
functions.description: Gets the current fill rule used for filling paths.
requirements: cr must be valid.

functions.name: cairo_get_line_width
functions.description: Gets the current stroke line width.
requirements: cr must be valid.

functions.name: cairo_get_hairline
functions.description: Returns whether hairline mode is set for stroking (device-pixel-aligned minimal width).
requirements: cr must be valid.

functions.name: cairo_get_line_cap
functions.description: Gets the current line cap style.
requirements: cr must be valid.

functions.name: cairo_get_line_join
functions.description: Gets the current line join style.
requirements: cr must be valid.

functions.name: cairo_get_miter_limit
functions.description: Gets the current miter limit for strokes.
requirements: cr must be valid.

functions.name: cairo_get_dash_count
functions.description: Returns the number of dash lengths in the current dash pattern.
requirements: cr must be valid.

functions.name: cairo_get_dash
functions.description: Retrieves the current dash pattern into the provided buffer and the dash offset.
requirements: cr must be valid.
If dashes is non-NULL, it must point to an array of at least cairo_get_dash_count() doubles.
offset may be NULL if the caller only wants dashes.

functions.name: cairo_get_matrix
functions.description: Retrieves the current transformation matrix of the context.
requirements: cr must be valid.
matrix must be a valid non-NULL output pointer.

functions.name: cairo_get_target
functions.description: Gets the target surface attached to the context (does not change refcount).
requirements: cr must be valid.
Reference the returned surface if keeping it beyond cr lifetime or changes.

functions.name: cairo_get_group_target
functions.description: Gets the current destination surface considering groups (top of group stack), without changing refcount.
requirements: cr must be valid.

functions.name: cairo_copy_path
functions.description: Creates and returns a copy of the current path, suitable for iteration or reuse.
requirements: cr must be valid.
Returned path must be freed with cairo_path_destroy().

functions.name: cairo_copy_path_flat
functions.description: Returns a copy of the current path with all curves approximated by straight line segments.
requirements: cr must be valid.
Free with cairo_path_destroy().

functions.name: cairo_append_path
functions.description: Appends the segments from path to the current path of the context.
requirements: cr must be valid.
path must be a valid cairo_path_t as returned by cairo_copy_path( _flat ).

functions.name: cairo_path_destroy
functions.description: Frees a cairo_path_t previously returned by cairo_copy_path or cairo_copy_path_flat.
requirements: path must be either NULL (no-op) or a path returned by cairo_copy_path(_flat) and not already destroyed.

functions.name: cairo_status
functions.description: Returns the last error status on the cairo context, or CAIRO_STATUS_SUCCESS.
requirements: cr must be valid.

functions.name: cairo_status_to_string
functions.description: Returns a human-readable static string for the given cairo_status_t value.
requirements: status must be a valid cairo_status_t value; new values may appear in newer cairo versions.
Returned pointer is static; do not free.

functions.name: cairo_device_reference
functions.description: Increments the reference count of the device and returns it.
requirements: device must be a valid cairo_device_t (NULL returns NULL).
Balance with cairo_device_destroy().

functions.name: cairo_device_get_type
functions.description: Returns the device backend/type.
requirements: device must be valid.

functions.name: cairo_device_status
functions.description: Returns the error status of the device.
requirements: device must be valid.

functions.name: cairo_device_acquire
functions.description: Acquires the device for exclusive access by the current thread for multi-threading synchronization.
requirements: device must be valid.
Caller must pair with cairo_device_release().
Do not reenter acquire on an already-acquired device by the same thread unless backend allows it.

functions.name: cairo_device_release
functions.description: Releases a device previously acquired with cairo_device_acquire().
requirements: device must be valid.
Device must have been successfully acquired by the current thread.

functions.name: cairo_device_flush
functions.description: Flushes any pending operations for the device.
requirements: device must be valid.

functions.name: cairo_device_finish
functions.description: Finishes the device, completing all pending operations and marking it unusable for further drawing.
requirements: device must be valid.
After finish, most operations on the device will fail; only destroy/reference queries are allowed.

functions.name: cairo_device_destroy
functions.description: Decrements the reference count of the device; when zero, destroys it.
requirements: device may be NULL (no-op).
Do not use after final unref.

functions.name: cairo_device_get_reference_count
functions.description: Returns the current reference count of the device.
requirements: device must be valid.

functions.name: cairo_device_get_user_data
functions.description: Gets previously set user data for the device and key, or NULL.
requirements: device must be valid.
key must be the same address used when setting data.

functions.name: cairo_device_set_user_data
functions.signature: cairo_status_t cairo_device_set_user_data (cairo_device_t *device, const cairo_user_data_key_t *key, void *user_data, cairo_destroy_func_t destroy);
functions.description: Associates user data with the device under key, with optional destructor.
requirements: device must be valid.
key must be a unique stable address.
If replacing, previous data’s destroy is called.
destroy may be NULL.

functions.name: cairo_surface_create_similar
functions.signature: cairo_surface_t * cairo_surface_create_similar (cairo_surface_t *other, cairo_content_t content, int width, int height);
functions.description: Creates a new surface optimized for drawing to the same backend as ‘other’, with given content and dimensions.
requirements: other must be a valid surface.
width and height must be non-negative; large sizes may return CAIRO_STATUS_INVALID_SIZE on use.
Check status with cairo_surface_status().

functions.name: cairo_surface_create_similar_image
functions.signature: cairo_surface_t * cairo_surface_create_similar_image (cairo_surface_t *other, cairo_format_t format, int width, int height);
functions.description: Creates an image surface compatible with ‘other’s device for efficient uploading, using the specified format and size.
requirements: other must be a valid surface.
format must be a valid cairo_format_t (not CAIRO_FORMAT_INVALID).
width and height must be >= 0 and within backend limits.
Check surface status on return.

functions.name: cairo_surface_map_to_image
functions.description: Maps a region of the surface into an image surface for direct pixel access. Returns an image surface representing the mapped region.
requirements: surface must be valid.
extents may be NULL to map the whole surface, or a valid rectangle in pixels.
Unmap the result with cairo_surface_unmap_image().
While mapped, modifications should be made through the returned image.

functions.name: cairo_surface_unmap_image
functions.description: Unmaps an image surface previously returned by cairo_surface_map_to_image(), flushing changes back if needed.
requirements: surface must be the same as the one passed to map.
image must be the exact image surface returned by map and not yet unmapped.

functions.name: cairo_surface_create_for_rectangle
functions.signature: cairo_surface_t * cairo_surface_create_for_rectangle (cairo_surface_t *target, double x, double y, double width, double height);
functions.description: Creates a subsurface that is a view onto a rectangular region of another surface.
requirements: target must be a valid surface.
The rectangle (x,y,width,height) must lie within the target surface’s extents for well-defined results.
The subsurface shares data with target; writing affects target.

functions.name: cairo_surface_create_observer
functions.description: Creates an observer surface that can record or observe operations performed on the target surface for profiling/debugging.
requirements: target must be valid.
mode must be a valid cairo_surface_observer_mode_t flag combination.

functions.name: cairo_surface_observer_add_paint_callback
functions.description: Registers a callback invoked on paint operations observed by the observer surface.
requirements: abstract_surface must be an observer surface created by cairo_surface_create_observer().
func must be non-NULL.
data is an opaque pointer passed to callback.

functions.name: cairo_surface_observer_add_mask_callback
functions.description: Registers a callback for mask operations observed by the observer surface.
requirements: abstract_surface must be an observer surface.
func must be non-NULL.

functions.name: cairo_surface_observer_add_fill_callback
functions.description: Registers a callback for fill operations observed by the observer surface.
requirements: abstract_surface must be an observer surface.
func must be non-NULL.

functions.name: cairo_surface_observer_add_stroke_callback
functions.description: Registers a callback for stroke operations observed by the observer surface.
requirements: abstract_surface must be an observer surface.
func must be non-NULL.

functions.name: cairo_surface_observer_add_glyphs_callback
functions.description: Registers a callback for glyph rendering operations observed by the observer surface.
requirements: abstract_surface must be an observer surface.
func must be non-NULL.

functions.name: cairo_surface_observer_add_flush_callback
functions.description: Registers a callback for flush events observed by the observer surface.
requirements: abstract_surface must be an observer surface.
func must be non-NULL.

functions.name: cairo_surface_observer_add_finish_callback
functions.description: Registers a callback for finish events observed by the observer surface.
requirements: abstract_surface must be an observer surface.
func must be non-NULL.

functions.name: cairo_surface_observer_print
functions.description: Serializes recorded observer data to an output stream via the provided write callback.
requirements: abstract_surface must be an observer surface with recording enabled to have data.
write_func must be non-NULL and return CAIRO_STATUS_SUCCESS on success.
closure is passed to write_func.

functions.name: cairo_surface_observer_elapsed
functions.description: Returns elapsed time collected by the observer surface (seconds).
requirements: abstract_surface must be an observer surface.

functions.name: cairo_device_observer_print
functions.description: Serializes recorded observer data for a device to an output stream.
requirements: abstract_device must be a device with observer capabilities.
write_func must be non-NULL.

functions.name: cairo_device_observer_elapsed
functions.description: Returns total elapsed time recorded by the device observer.
requirements: abstract_device must be a device with observer capabilities.

functions.name: cairo_device_observer_paint_elapsed
functions.description: Returns elapsed time spent in paint operations recorded by the device observer.
requirements: abstract_device must be an observer-enabled device.

functions.name: cairo_device_observer_mask_elapsed
functions.description: Returns elapsed time spent in mask operations recorded by the device observer.
requirements: abstract_device must be an observer-enabled device.

functions.name: cairo_device_observer_fill_elapsed
functions.description: Returns elapsed time spent in fill operations recorded by the device observer.
requirements: abstract_device must be an observer-enabled device.

functions.name: cairo_device_observer_stroke_elapsed
functions.description: Returns elapsed time spent in stroke operations recorded by the device observer.
requirements: abstract_device must be an observer-enabled device.

functions.name: cairo_device_observer_glyphs_elapsed
functions.description: Returns elapsed time spent in glyph operations recorded by the device observer.
requirements: abstract_device must be an observer-enabled device.

functions.name: cairo_surface_reference
functions.description: Increments the reference count of the surface and returns it.
requirements: surface must be valid (NULL returns NULL).
Balance with cairo_surface_destroy().

functions.name: cairo_surface_finish
functions.description: Finishes the surface, flushing and marking it as complete; no further drawing should be done.
requirements: surface must be valid.
After finish, only queries/destroy are valid.

functions.name: cairo_surface_destroy
functions.description: Decrements the refcount of the surface; frees it when it reaches zero.
requirements: surface may be NULL (no-op).
Do not use after final unref.

functions.name: cairo_surface_get_device
functions.description: Returns the device associated with the surface (does not change refcount).
requirements: surface must be valid.
Reference the device if keeping it.

functions.name: cairo_surface_get_reference_count
functions.description: Returns the current reference count of the surface.
requirements: surface must be valid.

functions.name: cairo_surface_status
functions.description: Returns the last error status for the surface.
requirements: surface must be valid.

functions.name: cairo_surface_get_type
functions.description: Returns the backend/type of the surface.
requirements: surface must be valid.

functions.name: cairo_surface_get_content
functions.description: Returns the content type (COLOR, ALPHA, COLOR_ALPHA) of the surface.
requirements: surface must be valid.

functions.name: cairo_surface_write_to_png
functions.description: Writes the contents of the surface to a PNG file on disk.
requirements: Available only if CAIRO_HAS_PNG_FUNCTIONS is enabled at build time.
surface must be valid.
filename must be a valid, writable path string.
Returns CAIRO_STATUS_PNG_ERROR on libpng errors.

functions.name: cairo_surface_write_to_png_stream
functions.description: Streams the surface as PNG via a user-provided write callback.
requirements: Available only if CAIRO_HAS_PNG_FUNCTIONS is enabled.
surface must be valid.
write_func must be non-NULL and adhere to cairo_write_func_t contract.

functions.name: cairo_surface_get_user_data
functions.description: Gets user data associated with the surface and key, or NULL.
requirements: surface must be valid.
key must match the address used to set data.

functions.name: cairo_surface_set_user_data
functions.signature: cairo_status_t cairo_surface_set_user_data (cairo_surface_t *surface, const cairo_user_data_key_t *key, void *user_data, cairo_destroy_func_t destroy);
functions.description: Associates user data with the surface under key, with optional destructor.
requirements: surface must be valid.
key must be a unique stable address.
If replacing existing data, prior destroy is called.
destroy may be NULL.

functions.name: cairo_surface_get_mime_data
functions.signature: void cairo_surface_get_mime_data (cairo_surface_t *surface, const char *mime_type, const unsigned char **data, unsigned long *length);
functions.description: Retrieves raw MIME data previously set on the surface for a given MIME type, if any.
requirements: surface must be valid.
mime_type must be a valid MIME string (e.g., CAIRO_MIME_TYPE_PNG).
data and length must be non-NULL output pointers if you want results; they will be set to NULL/0 if not present.

functions.name: cairo_surface_set_mime_data
functions.signature: cairo_status_t cairo_surface_set_mime_data (cairo_surface_t *surface, const char *mime_type, const unsigned char *data, unsigned long length, cairo_destroy_func_t destroy, void *closure);
functions.description: Attaches raw MIME data to the surface under the specified MIME type, for embedding/export purposes.
requirements: surface must be valid.
mime_type must be a supported/recognized MIME string.
data may be NULL with length 0 to clear existing data for the key.
If data is non-NULL, length must be the number of bytes available at data.
destroy may be NULL; if provided it will be called with closure to free data when no longer needed.

functions.name: cairo_surface_supports_mime_type
functions.description: Returns whether the surface backend supports the given MIME type for embedding.
requirements: surface must be valid.
mime_type must be a valid string.

functions.name: cairo_surface_get_font_options
functions.description: Retrieves the font rendering options recommended for this surface.
requirements: surface must be valid.
options must be a valid cairo_font_options_t pointer to receive values.

functions.name: cairo_surface_flush
functions.description: Flushes any pending drawing to the surface and synchronizes with the backend.
requirements: surface must be valid.

functions.name: cairo_surface_mark_dirty
functions.description: Notifies cairo that the entire image surface contents have been modified outside of cairo, so caches can be updated.
requirements: surface must be valid and typically an image surface or similar accepting dirty marks.
Call after external writes to surface memory.

functions.name: cairo_surface_mark_dirty_rectangle
functions.signature: void cairo_surface_mark_dirty_rectangle (cairo_surface_t *surface, int x, int y, int width, int height);
functions.description: Marks a rectangular region as modified outside cairo.
requirements: surface must be valid and support dirty marking.
width and height must be non-negative; rectangle should be within surface bounds.

functions.name: cairo_surface_set_device_scale
functions.signature: void cairo_surface_set_device_scale (cairo_surface_t *surface, double x_scale, double y_scale);
functions.description: Sets a scale factor between device pixels and surface logical units (e.g., for HiDPI).
requirements: surface must be valid.
x_scale and y_scale should be positive; zero or negative values are invalid.

functions.name: cairo_surface_get_device_scale
functions.description: Gets the device scale factors for the surface.
requirements: surface must be valid.
x_scale and y_scale must be non-NULL output pointers.

functions.name: cairo_surface_set_device_offset
functions.signature: void cairo_surface_set_device_offset (cairo_surface_t *surface, double x_offset, double y_offset);
functions.description: Sets an offset added to device-space coordinates for the surface (useful for sub-surfaces).
requirements: surface must be valid.

functions.name: cairo_surface_get_device_offset
functions.description: Gets the device offset applied to the surface.
requirements: surface must be valid.
x_offset and y_offset must be non-NULL output pointers.

functions.name: cairo_surface_set_fallback_resolution
functions.signature: void cairo_surface_set_fallback_resolution (cairo_surface_t *surface, double x_pixels_per_inch, double y_pixels_per_inch);
functions.description: Sets the fallback (bitmap) resolution for vector surfaces when rasterization is required.
requirements: surface must be valid.
x_pixels_per_inch and y_pixels_per_inch should be positive.

functions.name: cairo_surface_get_fallback_resolution
functions.description: Gets the fallback resolution settings for the surface.
requirements: surface must be valid.
x_pixels_per_inch and y_pixels_per_inch must be non-NULL output pointers.

functions.name: cairo_surface_copy_page
functions.description: Emits the current page for multi-page surfaces, keeping the contents for further drawing on a new page.
requirements: surface must be valid and support paginated output (no-op otherwise).

functions.name: cairo_surface_show_page
functions.description: Finishes the current page and clears it for a new page on paginated surfaces.
requirements: surface must be valid and support paginated output.

functions.name: cairo_surface_has_show_text_glyphs
functions.description: Indicates whether the surface supports efficient show_text_glyphs operations.
requirements: surface must be valid.

functions.name: cairo_image_surface_create
functions.signature: cairo_surface_t * cairo_image_surface_create (cairo_format_t format, int width, int height);
functions.description: Creates an image surface of the given pixel format and size in memory.
requirements: format must be a valid cairo_format_t (not CAIRO_FORMAT_INVALID).
width and height must be >= 0 and within implementation limits.
Check surface status after creation.

functions.name: cairo_format_stride_for_width
functions.description: Computes the minimum valid stride (byte offset between rows) for an image of given format and width.
requirements: format must be a valid cairo_format_t.
width must be >= 0.

functions.name: cairo_image_surface_create_for_data
functions.signature: cairo_surface_t * cairo_image_surface_create_for_data (unsigned char *data, cairo_format_t format, int width, int height, int stride);
functions.description: Wraps user-provided pixel memory as an image surface.
requirements: data must point to a buffer large enough for height rows with the given stride.
format must be valid and compatible with the pixel data.
width and height must be >= 0; stride must meet format alignment and be >= width*bytes_per_pixel (rounded as required).
The data buffer must remain valid and unchanged in format/layout for the life of the surface or until finish.

functions.name: cairo_image_surface_get_data
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the pixel data buffer for an image surface.
requirements: surface must be an image surface.
If you modify the data, call cairo_surface_mark_dirty() or mark_dirty_rectangle() afterward.

functions.name: cairo_image_surface_get_format
functions.description: Returns the pixel format for an image surface.
requirements: surface must be an image surface.

functions.name: cairo_image_surface_get_width
functions.description: Returns the width in pixels of an image surface.
requirements: surface must be an image surface.

functions.name: cairo_image_surface_get_height
functions.description: Returns the height in pixels of an image surface.
requirements: surface must be an image surface.

functions.name: cairo_image_surface_get_stride
functions.description: Returns the stride (bytes per row) of an image surface.
requirements: surface must be an image surface.

functions.name: cairo_image_surface_create_from_png
functions.description: Creates an image surface by loading a PNG file from disk.
requirements: Available only if CAIRO_HAS_PNG_FUNCTIONS is enabled.
filename must reference a readable PNG file.
On error, returns a surface in error state; check cairo_surface_status().

functions.name: cairo_image_surface_create_from_png_stream
functions.description: Creates an image surface by reading PNG data using the supplied read callback.
requirements: Available only if CAIRO_HAS_PNG_FUNCTIONS is enabled.
read_func must be non-NULL and conform to cairo_read_func_t.
closure is passed to the callback.

functions.name: cairo_recording_surface_create
functions.description: Creates a recording surface that records drawing commands for later playback or analysis. Optional extents bound ink extents.
requirements: content must be a valid cairo_content_t.
extents may be NULL for unbounded recording or a valid rectangle pointer.

functions.name: cairo_recording_surface_ink_extents
functions.signature: void cairo_recording_surface_ink_extents (cairo_surface_t *surface, double *x0, double *y0, double *width, double *height);
functions.description: Queries the bounding box of inked (drawn) area on a recording surface.
requirements: surface must be a recording surface.
x0, y0, width, height must be non-NULL output pointers.

functions.name: cairo_recording_surface_get_extents
functions.description: Retrieves the extents rectangle for a recording surface, if it has bounded extents.
requirements: surface must be a recording surface.
extents must be a valid non-NULL pointer to receive the bounds.
Returns FALSE if the surface is unbounded.

functions.name: cairo_pattern_create_raster_source
functions.signature: cairo_pattern_t * cairo_pattern_create_raster_source (void *user_data, cairo_content_t content, int width, int height);
functions.description: Creates a raster-source pattern whose pixel data is provided dynamically via callbacks.
requirements: content specifies pattern content; must be valid.
width and height specify nominal size; must be >= 0.
After creation, set callbacks via cairo_raster_source_pattern_set_* before use.

functions.name: cairo_raster_source_pattern_set_callback_data
functions.description: Associates user callback data with a raster-source pattern.
requirements: pattern must be a raster-source pattern.
data is opaque and stored for retrieval in callbacks.

functions.name: cairo_raster_source_pattern_get_callback_data
functions.description: Retrieves the user callback data previously set on a raster-source pattern.
requirements: pattern must be a raster-source pattern.

functions.name: cairo_raster_source_pattern_set_acquire
functions.signature: void cairo_raster_source_pattern_set_acquire (cairo_pattern_t *pattern, cairo_raster_source_acquire_func_t acquire, cairo_raster_source_release_func_t release);
functions.description: Sets the acquire and release callbacks used to provide pixel data for a raster-source pattern.
requirements: pattern must be a raster-source pattern.
acquire and release should both be non-NULL for proper operation.

functions.description: Increments the refcount of a pattern and returns it.
